# Backlog — the erratic-work tracker

> 2 open item(s). Roadmap = planned feature/value work; backlog = the follow-up, trivial, or urgent work that surfaces erratically. Capture with `/backlog` or `roadmap backlog add`; launch a small item directly with `roadmap grab <id>`; promote a bigger one into the roadmap with `roadmap promote <id> --pi <pi>`.
